full_page.content:
ST. FELIX MONASTERY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA December 18th 1946
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Mich'n
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you again. ...
Just a word to ask you in case you send me anything .... please do not have it elaborate - just something I'll not be ashamed to use and may remember the donor in using. Pl. pardon haste and brevity. ... Praised be Jesus!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
